fusions.name: Sharp Command
fusions.desc: Snaps out a command that hits a target up to 7 tiles away for 12 resonating damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Word of Power
fusions.desc: Barks a cone 5 tiles long that deals 30 arcane damage to everything in it and ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Drilled Response
fusions.desc: Increases your cast speed by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Praise Earned
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
